svg.title: Callvale after: queues between the steps and a topic for results
svg.desc: After: an upload to Amazon S3 sends an event to the uploads queue. The start-job function reads it and sends work to the convert queue. Conversion workers in an Auto Scaling group read the convert queue. The save-results function publishes to the transcript-ready topic, which sends a copy to the webhooks queue and the indexing queue. The convert queue has a dead-letter queue for repeated failures.
